names: CIQ's two EBITDAs are named apart wherever either prints (W81, SP-D20): the annual export's LTM column is CIQ's annual LTM EBITDA (the basis line, the lease line's margin, the anchor split's refusals; it read reported LTM EBITDA) and the quarterly export's four quarters are CIQ's four-quarter EBITDA (the ex-lease band's denominator, the at-price line, the EBITDA reconciliation); after rent only qualifies a named figure; the renderer prints the new names on a page built or refreshed at this vintage and keeps the old words on an older page; the LTM-quarters check names the cause of an EBITDA DIFFER where the annual Cash Flow's Other Amortization reconciles it at the check's own tolerance, and otherwise says the cause was not read
